mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL( TIMESTAMPDIFF( MONTH, (SELECT MIN(tradingHours) FROM bookKeepingBill WHERE userId = #{userId}), (SELECT MAX(tradingHours) FROM bookKeepingBill WHERE userId = #{userId}) ), 0 ) FROM dual WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookKeepingBill WHERE userId = #{userId} HAVING COUNT(id) >= 2) UNION ALL SELECT 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookKeepingBill WHERE userId = #{userId} HAVING COUNT(id) >= 2) LIMIT 1
